create_GMParam: create a GMParam object to configure global model hyperparameters including frequency, window sizes, and cell type
build_DilatedRNNStack: build a DilatedRNNStack module with LSTM2Cell or S2Cell for time series forecasting with configurable dilation
compute_PinballLoss: compute the weighted pinball loss for quantile forecasts against true target values
preprocess_gmpreprocess: preprocess time series data for global models by filling missing values and filtering short series
extract_GMFeature: extract time series features like tsfeatures, last_date, or last_hour for global model input
